answer: Locks are recorded in oasis, expire in harbor, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 125 aliases therefore needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3495 identities would post 3173 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
